tips.text: Pledge Perrin or New Loka first and max both before touching Red Veil, Steel Meridian, Suda or Hexis.
Run the daily Perrin Syndicate Alerts and grab every medallion; they are the only way past the daily cap.
Play whatever gives the most Affinity per minute; no mission type is special for Perrin standing.
Swap pledges freely to whichever syndicate you are levelling that day; it costs nothing.
Check your Steel Meridian standing before pledging Perrin; the drain ignores the daily cap and one player lost about 200,000 in a single mission.
Treat this as a patience gate, not a skill gate; the weapon is cheap and nobody struggles to get it.
